description: Allocadia’s Marketing Performance Management cloud software transforms how marketers plan, budget, analyze, and optimize return on investment. Allocadia connects to leading customer relationship management, finance, social media, resource management, and marketing automation systems delivering the only way to provide complete visibility into marketing performance.

Arkestro is the leading Predictive Procurement Orchestration platform. Built to amplify the impact of procurement’s influence, Arkestro helps enterprises deliver a 2-5x lift on cost savings attributed to everyday purchasing and sourcing cycles. Top enterprises leverage Arkestro’s behavioral science, game theory and machine learning to predict and win faster value across every category of addressable spend.

Bedrock Analytics is a sales analytics and visualization platform for consumer products manufacturers and retailers. Bedrock’s cloud software simplifies the process of extracting actionable insights from existing retail sales data by combining proven CPG analyses with next generation visualization software.

Birdie helps companies achieve indisputable product leadership and drive sustainable business growth by using cutting-edge AI to analyze millions of consumer and competitive data points, generating actionable insights and business recommendations.
Brevity is an AI-driven role playing platform that helps everyone master conversational skills.

BrightEdge is the leading enterprise SEO platform and the trusted partner of the largest and most recognizable brands in the world. BrightEdge helps marketers rise above the increasing clutter of the web and drive organic revenue from search engines across the globe in a measurable, predictable way. BrightEdge exited via management buyout in 2024.

CafeX enables organizations in regulated industries — healthcare, banking, insurance, and government — to re-imagine & optimize how they digitally engage with employees, customers and partners by leveraging existing investments in operational systems and unifying fragmented, often custom, siloed solutions that hinder internal efficiency and compromise customer and partner experiences.

CalmSea‘s Social Commerce Optimization solution helps leading retailers and brands monetize their social fanbases. CalmSea’s predictive platform applies deep customer behavior analysis to optimize the right promotion for the right consumer with the right enagement tactic, resulting in higher conversions and top-line revenues.

Contentstack is a market-leading API-first content hub that sits at the intersection of CMS (content management systems) and DXP (digital experience platforms). This new breed of CMS platform gives developers and marketers a way to engage audiences in real time across virtually any delivery platform including mobile devices, wearable devices, chat bots, digital assistants, kiosks, etc., as well as the web. Contentstack allows developers and marketers to work together seamlessly to manage and deliver digital content across the entire enterprise. Marquee customers of this award-winning platform include companies like Amway, Best Buy, Cisco, Dell, Ellie Mae, Express, Farm Bureau Insurance, J.D. Power, Marriott, Martha Stewart, Miami HEAT, and Sky. See recent news about Contentstack.

Continual AI is a commercial AI platform designed for building, deploying, and managing AI copilots for business applications. The platform enables organizations to automate tasks, enhance human capabilities, and drive continuous improvement by creating AI agents that work alongside employees.

Hoopla.net helps organizations worldwide improve performance by steering the actions and behaviors of employees through visualization and game mechanics. Tightly integrated into 3rd party data systems such as Salesforce.com, companies can create stats, goals, actions, and competitions and display a variety of performance information on large screen animated displays and through a web browser.

Influitive helps considered-purchase companies (B2B, high price B2C) generate qualified leads and shorten buying processes. The Influitive AdvocateHub massively increases the amount of customer advocacy that is so critical to accelerating today’s social buying processes – more referral leads, more reference calls, social proof assets and social media interaction. The defining characteristic of the product is a superior advocate experience, delivered through a fun, game-like interface.

Intelo.ai is an enterprise AI platform transforming retail planning and merchandising. The company helps merchants, planners, and buyers make faster, smarter, and more collaborative decisions by embedding specialized AI agents directly into their workflows. Unlike traditional analytics dashboards, Intelo.ai’s Collaborative Intelligence system learns from human context and automates complex operational processes — from forecasting and assortment planning to inventory management and replenishment. Built on proprietary data pipelines and decision-support models, the platform augments human expertise with precision and scale. Intelo.ai’s mission is to empower retailers to move beyond reactive reporting toward proactive, intelligent action.

IP Author is a generative AI platform transforming how companies and law firms create, manage, and protect intellectual property. Purpose-built for corporate patent teams and IP professionals, IP Author automates the most time-intensive parts of the patent lifecycle — from invention disclosure and prior art search to drafting, classification, and prosecution. Using proprietary large language models fine-tuned on global patent data, the platform generates complete, editable applications — including flowcharts and block diagrams — in minutes. By combining human expertise with machine precision, IP Author enables teams to shift from manual document production to high-value strategic innovation.

Jacobi is a next-generation intelligence platform for investment managers. Their risk and portfolio-construction tools enable practitioners to work and communicate through intuitive storyboards. Built with a multi-asset focus Jacobi’s platform facilitates the transfer of manager insights, generating better investment ideas and deeper levels of engagement between an investment manager and client.

JetStream Software develops cloud-native software to enable cloud service providers to have the ability to deliver disaster recovery and mobility services. JetStream solutions are all-software, hypervisor-integrated designed to empower infrastructure spanning multiple data centers and cloud services.

Joinder provides a cloud collaboration solution for legal departments. Joinder’s product centralizes work and work product in a single system consisting of workrooms for each matter and a file system to organize completed work and records and associated workflows.

Labra , the hybrid-cloud commerce marketplace platform is reshaping B2B Cloud GTM, infusing automation, clarity, and intelligence to simplify transactions for cloud-native software stakeholders — from buyers and sellers to partners.
mpathic AI builders train, evaluate, and calibrate models for nuanced human behavior and high-risk environments, so they perform safely in the real world.

Opsmatic builds tools to free ops teams from time-consuming mundane tasks so they can play a more strategic role, proactively improving performance, deployments, and reducing downtime. Product is currently in Beta. Acquired 10/2015 by New Relic (NEWR)

Perceptive Panda helps companies catalyze the growth mindset. Customer interviews are a crucial part of the growth mindset because they provide the data and insights needed for continuous improvement. But interviews are impossible to scale in a cost effective manner. AI holds the potential to address this challenge. But this is a hard problem, and LLMs alone won’t solve it. We’re combining proven natural language technology along with LLMs, so that businesses can confidently use AI to uncover previously hidden insights across the customer lifecycle.
Perceptix can do what no other inspection software can: see patterns, interpret environments, and evolve in real time so our customers can:

PEX provides video content creators and marketers the ability to identify use of their content across any public sharing platform. The powerful technology recognizes content independent of meta data, editing, or length.
Provarity is the first intuitive presales platform built on an AI native architecture, revolutionizing how technical evaluations are analyzed and automated.

Pyze is the leading Digital Transformation analytics platform for Enterprise Applications to maximize process efficiency and productivity of modernization initiatives through low-code process mining and productivity analytics. Pyze is a pioneering developer of Process Intelligence solutions, dedicated to helping businesses navigate their digital transformation journeys through insightful, data-driven decision-making frameworks. By offering deep visibility into business processes, Pyze enables organizations to uncover opportunities for improvement, automation, and optimization, facilitating continuous innovation and growth. The Pyze Process Intelligence Platform auto-discovers complex end-to-end business process flows to surface process bottlenecks, activity hotspots, and user experience optimization opportunities. The AI-Driven platform proactively identifies emerging issues, quality concerns, and training needs for success. Pyze customers include Fortune 500 companies across a number of verticals including Banking, Financial Services and Insurance, Manufacturing and Logistics, Telecommunications, Healthcare, and Public Sector.

Red Aril delivers a Data Management and Audience Optimization Platform (DMP) that puts websites and advertisers in charge of their audience data, enabling them to profit from audience targeting and site personalization. Red Aril’s DMP helps its customers reach quality target audiences by using predictive modeling that integrates all data — any source, any type. Utilizing these models, Red Aril lets sites effectively use data to drive revenue. Acquired 12/2011 by Hearst Corporation – iCrossing

Sense Platform is building the right way for teams and enterprise to do data science — a radically better data science platform that supports the most powerful tools available and is delivered at a fraction of the cost of traditional solutions. Acquired 3/2016 by Cloudera

TAZI.AI believes in ML for All. Tazi’s vision is a world in which every human uses ML as a means to make better choices. Shaped by real-life experience with customers, TAZI’s SaaS solutions keep business experts in the driver’s seat while empowering data science teams. With 60+ years of experience in Machine Learning systems and software deployments at Caltech and MIT, Tazi’s actionable solutions can be created and deployed easily within days. Business users can create, monitor, contribute to and collaborate with the ML solutions as business conditions continuously change. This is possible thanks to TAZI’s patented continuous learning, explainable AI, human-in-the-loop differentiators. TAZI is headquartered in San Francisco, is a Gartner Cool Vendor in Core AI Technologies, and is cited as a Responsible, Explainable AI vendor.

Wild Pockets is bringing 3D to your web browser. Game developers and designers can sign up on the Wild Pockets website and instantly begin developing interactive 3D content, such as games, simulations and interactive ads. Content developed in Wild Pockets can be embedded and distributed instantly on any website anywhere online, similar to a YouTube video. A built-in micro-transaction system and marketplace enables developers to monetize the content they have developed. Acquired 12/2010 by Autodesk, Inc. (ADSK)

Xactly Corporation is the market leader in on-demand sales performance management. The company’s flagship product, Xactly Incent, enables sales and finance executives to design, implement, manage, audit and optimize sales compensation management programs easily and affordably. Xactly helps companies improve operational performance, optimize sales effectiveness, proactively manage risk and compliance, and maximize profits. The Xactly family of products is used by sales and finance executives, compensation analysts, sales operations and sales professionals across a variety of industries, ranging from SMBs to large enterprises. Xactly IPO NYSE: XTLY 6/2015. Acquired ($564M) by Vista Equity Partners 5/2017. Twitter | LinkedIn | Facebook
